newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Saudi Commercial Bank, Saudi Cairo Bank likely to merge in next five months, Prince Al-Waleed says.
- National Bank of Fujairah borrows $60 million from a group of international banks.
- Qassim Cement Company of Saudi Arabia posts 152 million riyals net profit in 1996.
- National Bank of Kuwait makes $286.4 million net profits in 1996.
- Dallah Albaraka plans to construct four hotels in Mecca at a cost of 700 million riyals.
